info.title: WhatsMark.io REST API
info.description:
WhatsMark public tenant REST API (v1).

**Base URL:** `https://api.whatsmark.io`

**Auth:** Every authenticated request sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, where the token is a workspace API token created under **Settings → API Keys** in your tenant dashboard.

**Scopes:** Each endpoint's description lists the token ability it requires. Create your token with the matching scopes.

**Pagination:** List endpoints return `{ data, links: { next, prev }, meta }`. Large/append-only collections (contacts, group members, webhooks) use opaque cursor pagination — follow `links.next` until it is `null`. `per_page` is clamped to 5–100.

**Async sends:** Message and OTP sends return `202` and are processed on the queue.

**Error envelope:**
```json
{ "message": "...", "error_code": "...", "status": 4xx }
```

**Modules:** Auth/Account · Channels · Contacts · Statuses · Sources · Groups · Labels · Templates · Messages · Conversations · OTP.

get.description:
**Scope required:** `account:read`

Health / identity probe. Validates the full auth chain (token → workspace → subscription → feature gate → quota). Returns who you are and which abilities your token has.

Use this first to confirm your token is working.

**Scope required:** `account:read`

Returns the calling workspace's identity, active plan, and subscription state.

**Scope required:** `account:read`

Returns current plan limits and consumption for all metered features: contacts, conversations, campaigns, media storage, and API requests.

`limit: null` and `unlimited: true` means no cap on that feature.

**Scope required:** `channels:read`

Returns all connected messaging accounts for the workspace across **every platform** (WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, …), each with their endpoints nested under `endpoints`.

All accounts include `id`, `platform`, `name`, `account_id`, `status`, `connection_method`, `is_default`, `connected_at` and `endpoints`. WhatsApp accounts additionally include the phone-number shape (`waba_id`, `business_profile`, `mm_lite_status`, `phone_numbers`) for backward compatibility. The default channel is listed first.

**Scope required:** `channels:read`

Returns a single connected account by its ID on any platform, with its endpoints nested under `endpoints`. WhatsApp accounts additionally include the phone-number shape (`waba_id`, `phone_numbers`, …) for backward compatibility.

Returns `404` if the channel does not exist or belongs to a different workspace.

**Scope:** `contacts:read`

Cursor-paginated list of contacts. Filters: `search`, `type`, `contact_status_id`, `contact_source_id`, `group_id`, `per_page` (5–100, default 50). Merged contacts are excluded.

post.description:
**Scope:** `contacts:write`

Create a contact. `phone` is required and must be unique in E.164-ish form. Honours the `contacts` plan limit → `422 limit_reached` at cap.

phone.description: Must be unique within your workspace.

value.message: You have reached your contacts limit.

post.description:
**Scope:** `contacts:write`

Create up to 100 contacts in one call. Each item is validated and created independently — the response reports `created` and per-index `errors` (partial success).

phone: The phone has already been taken.

post.description:
**Scope:** `contacts:write`

Apply an action to up to **500** contacts by id (synchronous). `action`: `delete`, `change_status` (+`contact_status_id`), `change_type` (+`type`), `activate`, `deactivate`. Returns the affected count.

_For bulk label/group changes use the per-contact update or the group membership endpoints._

**Scope:** `contacts:write`

Merge a duplicate contact (`loser_id`) into this one (the path id, the winner). Conversations, identities, campaign recipients, labels/groups and custom fields are re-pointed to the winner; the loser is soft-deleted and marked merged. Returns the winner. `422 invalid_merge` if either side is already merged or you merge a contact into itself.

value.message: Cannot merge a contact into itself.

get.description:
**Scope:** `templates:read`

Length-aware paginated templates. Filters: `channel_id`, `status` (e.g. APPROVED), `category` (e.g. utility), `platform` (e.g. whatsapp), `per_page`.

post.description:
**Scope:** `templates:write`

Create a **standard** WhatsApp template (text/media header optional, required body, optional footer + buttons) and submit it to Meta. Synchronous — returns `201` with the template in `PENDING`, or `422 meta_rejected` if Meta refuses it (e.g. duplicate name). Poll `GET /templates/{id}` (or `POST /templates/sync`) for the final `APPROVED`/`REJECTED` status, which arrives asynchronously from Meta.

`name` must be lowercase letters, digits and underscores. `category`: `MARKETING` / `UTILITY` / `AUTHENTICATION`. Body/header variables use `{{1}}` placeholders. Media (`IMAGE`/`VIDEO`/`DOCUMENT`) headers require a pre-obtained `header.media_handle` (Meta Resumable Upload API). Authentication & carousel template types are not exposed in v1.1.

**Scope:** `templates:read`

Triggers a background sync of templates from Meta for all (or a given) connected account. Returns `202` — templates update asynchronously.

value.message: No connected WhatsApp account to sync.

post.summary: Send Template Message / Send Text Message
post.description:
**Scope:** `messages:send`

Send an approved template message. The send is queued on Horizon and returns `202` immediately. Pass `template_data.components` to fill template variables. Optional `Idempotency-Key` via `idempotency_key`.

_Sends are throttled to Meta's per-number rate (mps + 6s pair-rate); over the limit returns `429 send_rate_limited` with a `Retry-After` header._

---

**Scope:** `messages:send`

Send a free-form text reply. Only allowed inside an open 24-hour customer-service window, otherwise `422 window_expired`.

_Sends are throttled to Meta's per-number rate (mps + 6s pair-rate); over the limit returns `429 send_rate_limited` with a `Retry-After` header._

value.message: The 24-hour messaging window has expired. Send a template instead.
Contact has opted out of marketing messages.
Send rate limit reached for this WhatsApp number. Please retry shortly.

post.description:

Convenience endpoint to send a template to a specific contact by path ID. Body omits `contact_id`/`type` (implied).

_Sends are throttled to Meta's per-number rate (mps + 6s pair-rate); over the limit returns `429 send_rate_limited` with a `Retry-After` header._

get.description:
**Scope:** `messages:read`

Fetch a single message with its delivery status (`queued` → `sent` → `delivered` → `read`, or `failed`).

**Scope:** `conversations:read`

Cursor-paginated conversations, newest first. Filters: `contact_id`, `channel_id`, `status` (`open`/`pending`/`assigned`/`resolved`/`closed`), `per_page` (5–100, default 25).

Each item carries `last_message_at` and `is_window_open` (whether a free-form text reply is currently allowed). Pairs with the `message.received` webhook for a live inbox.

**Scope:** `conversations:read`

Cursor-paginated message history for a conversation, newest first. Follow `links.next` until `null` to walk the full thread.

post.description:
**Scope:** `otp:send`

Send a one-time passcode over WhatsApp using an APPROVED **authentication**-category template. The 6-digit code is generated server-side, hashed at rest, and delivered via the template's body + URL button. Returns `202` with an opaque `reference`.

Rate limits: 5/hour and 20/day per phone; 60s resend cooldown. `channel_id` must be a WhatsApp phone-number (endpoint) channel; `template_id` must belong to its account and be authentication-category + APPROVED.

_Sends are throttled to Meta's per-number rate (mps + 6s pair-rate); over the limit returns `429 send_rate_limited` with a `Retry-After` header._

value.message: Template not found, not approved, or not an authentication category.
Hourly OTP limit reached for this number. Try again later.
Send rate limit reached for this WhatsApp number. Please retry shortly.

get.description:
**Scope:** `otp:verify`

Returns the OTP's current `status` (`pending` / `verified` / `expired` / `cancelled`) and `remaining_attempts`.

delete.description:
**Scope:** `otp:send`

Cancel an active OTP. Returns `204`. A verified/expired/cancelled OTP returns `422 otp_inactive`.

post.description:
**Scope:** `otp:verify`

Submit the code the user received. On success `status` becomes `verified`. Wrong codes decrement `remaining_attempts` (`invalid_code`); other failures: `otp_expired`, `already_verified`, `max_attempts_reached`, `otp_cancelled`.

**Scope:** `otp:send`

Issue a fresh code on the same `reference`, resetting attempts and extending expiry. Subject to the 60s cooldown (`resend_cooldown`) and hourly/daily limits.

_Sends are throttled to Meta's per-number rate (mps + 6s pair-rate); over the limit returns `429 send_rate_limited` with a `Retry-After` header._

value.message: Please wait before requesting another OTP.
Send rate limit reached for this WhatsApp number. Please retry shortly.
